anchors: re-Read it before the next Edit of that table
decision: After the reformat hook realigns a table, re-Read the rows before the next Edit of that table.

evidence.text: Seen in this session: a Rust table cell edit realigned 15 rows of the table. GREEN opus and haiku re-Read before the second edit.

reopen_if: The hook stops realigning on Write/Edit, or Edit starts matching whitespace-insensitively.
why: Realigning rewrites every row's padding, so an old_string copied from an earlier Read fails 'String to replace not found'; a public install has no memory line saying so.
